source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.4, printed pages 331-332.

items: Chromatography ki techniques organic synthesis mein products ko alag karne, nikalne aur saaf karne ke liye bohat mufeed hain, aur qualitative aur quantitative tajziye aur madde ki purity tay karne mein utni hi aham.
Chromatography dyes, drugs aur pesticides jaise pecheeda chemicals pehchanne ke liye bohat mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: Paper chromatography ke teen amali istemalat dein (exercise Q.5).
blocks.explanation: Organic synthesis ke product ki purity jaanchna (ek spot ya kai); syahi ya khurak ke rang mein dyes ko maloom dyes se Rf qeematein mila kar pehchanna; aur namoone mein drugs ya pesticide ki baqiyat ka reference compounds ke muqable pata lagana.

items: Istemalat: synthetic products ko alag, nikalna aur saaf karna; qualitative aur quantitative tajziya; purity ki jaanch; dyes, drugs aur pesticides ki pehchan.
